exposure: painless nursing (interventions in terms of environment, labor process, and delivery procedure)
outcome: stress response (malondialdehyde (MDA), reactive oxygen species (ROS), superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels)
cohort: The study included 124 parturients who were transferred to cesarean delivery due to the failure of natural childbirth via labor analgesia.
finding: Painless nursing for cesarean delivery parturients significantly improved sleep quality, reduced pain, anxiety, and stress response, and resulted in higher nursing satisfaction compared to routine nursing.
